description: The model's active articles not yet on Amazon become ONE listing with variations — Amazon's "variation family"; call it a model with variations when talking to the user: a parent whose SKU is the model's code (no price, no quantity) and a child listing per article, varying by colour and/or size — the theme is chosen from what the Amazon product type declares. Every listing is first validated by Amazon (VALIDATION_PREVIEW); only when ALL of them would be accepted is the family created — a REAL publication: the parent first, then each child with its price and quantity. Run check_amazon_variation_family first. Refused until the owner switches on AI publishing, and while listing creation is not armed on the Amazon connection. Returns the same report with statuses created, failed, notAttempted or notChecked. A big model takes more than one call: notChecked and notAttempted both mean the run ran out of time, so call again — a dry run an article passed is kept for an hour while its data stays the same, created articles are skipped, the parent and the theme stay, and the rest continue. Never tell the user the family is live unless the children say created. The result echoes the workspace.

modelId.description: A product model id (the model a product's modelId points at; get_product shows it).

title: Publish a model with variations on Amazon
